author: anon-df5e95db
content: Multiple caches (BAM HeaderView tid_by_name, BCF HeaderView id_cache, tbx Reader tid_by_name/cached_seqnames, faidx Reader) use String or Vec<u8> as HashMap keys and cached values. These are heap-allocated, never mutated after construction, and frequently passed to C FFI (needing NUL termination). Investigate replacing with a compact inline string type that: (1) avoids heap allocation for short strings (SSO), (2) guarantees NUL termination for zero-cost CStr conversion, (3) is readonly after construction. Candidates: compact_str, smol_str, or a custom CString8-backed type. Related to CL-31 (HashMap key efficiency).
